overrides.AppLogs | where Message has 'error': SELECT * FROM AppLogs WHERE Message LIKE '% error %'
overrides.Orders | extend IsLarge = Amount > 1000: SELECT IsLarge, COUNT(*) FROM Orders GROUP BY IsLarge
overrides.SecurityEvent | where TimeGenerated > ag:
SELECT TimeGenerated, Account, Computer
FROM SecurityEvent
WHERE TimeGenerated > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND IsHighSeverity = true
